meta.title: TeamVerse AI
meta.description: Virtual office communications for distributed teams.

topbar.searchUnavailable: Global search isn't built yet. In Communications, use “Jump to a conversation”.
topbar.availabilityHint: You choose this. It is never calculated from your activity.

auth.signInSubtitle: Use the email address your organization invited.
auth.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match an account.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.inviteOnly: TeamVerse AI is invite-only. Ask your organization admin for an invitation link.

invite.title: You're invited
invite.existingAccount: This email already has an account. Sign in first, then open this link again to join.
invite.wrongAccount: You're signed in as {email}, but this invitation is for a different address.
invite.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask your admin for a new one.
invite.accepted: This invitation has already been used.
invite.serviceUnavailable: Invitations can't be accepted until the server's Supabase service key is configured.
invite.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

states.unconfiguredBody: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY (see .env.example), then restart the dev server.
states.noOrgTitle: You're not in an organization yet
states.noOrgBody: Ask an admin to send you an invitation link.
states.forbiddenTitle: You don't have access to this page
states.forbiddenBody: This area is limited to organization admins.
states.notFoundBody: The page you're looking for doesn't exist.
states.errorBody: The page failed to load. Try again, and contact your admin if it keeps happening.

comingSoon.title: {section} isn't built yet
comingSoon.body: This area arrives in Phase {phase}. Nothing here is simulated.
comingSoon.conferences: Calls and meeting rooms are Phase 4.
comingSoon.ai: AI features are Phase 6 and always require explicit consent.

admin.title: Organization
admin.inviteCreated: Invitation created. Copy this link and send it to {email}. It expires in 7 days and is shown only once.
admin.inviteEmailNotSent: Email delivery isn't configured, so send the link yourself.
admin.privacyNote: Admins manage membership and roles. Admins cannot read private conversations.

devGallery.title: Design system
devGallery.subtitle: Tokens and base components rebuilt from the Stitch design. Development only.

office.performanceHint: Lower resolution, no shadows, renders only on change.
office.presenceNote: Presence is ephemeral and shows only the availability each person chose. Nothing is tracked or stored.
office.canvasLabel: 3D office floor. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, right-drag to pan. Use the people list to select someone with the keyboard.
office.webglUnavailable: 3D isn't available on this device, so the 2D floor plan is shown.
office.noLayout: This organization has no active office layout yet.
office.selectHint: Select someone to see their profile.

profile.label: Profile of {name}
profile.screenShareHint: Only during an active call, after you choose to share.

directory.subtitle: Everyone in {org}. Status shows only while someone is connected.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Public channels are open to everyone in {org}. Private channels are invite-only and never listed here.
channels.name: Channel name
channels.nameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, up to 80 characters.
channels.publicHint: Anyone in the organization can find and join it.
channels.privateHint: Only people you add can see it.
channels.nameTaken: A channel with that name already exists.
channels.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.

comms.unread: {count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}
comms.noConversationsHint: Start a direct message or browse public channels.
comms.selectConversationHint: Pick a channel or person, or start something new.

connection.reconnecting: Reconnecting. New messages will appear when the connection is back.
connection.offline: You're offline. Messages you send will go out when you reconnect.
connection.demo: Demo transport: nothing leaves this browser.

thread.notFoundHint: It may have been deleted, or you're not a member.
thread.editHint: Enter to save · Esc to cancel
thread.confirmDeleteHint: Its text and files are removed for everyone. This can't be undone.
thread.actionFailed: That didn't work. Please try again.
thread.newBelow: {count, plural, one {# new message} other {# new messages}}
thread.beginningDirect: This is the beginning of your conversation with {name}.

composer.label: Write a message
composer.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
composer.fileTooMany: You can attach up to 10 files per message.
composer.tooLong: Messages can be up to {max} characters.
composer.sendFailed: Couldn't send. Check your connection and retry.

details.label: Conversation details
details.privacyNote: Only members can read this conversation, organization admins included. Messages are encrypted in transit (TLS), not end-to-end.
details.receiptsNote: Read receipts count only people who choose to share them. Change yours in Settings.

newConversation.title: New message
newConversation.description: Message one person, or pick several people to start a group.
newConversation.startGroup: Create group with {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.readReceiptsHint: When on, people in your conversations can see when you've read their messages. When off, you're never counted in “Read by”.
settings.moreSoon: Notification, call and language settings arrive in later phases.
